U01–U08: local/proposal deliveries retained. U09: confirmed UI fixes, regression checks, keyboard/reflow, export fallback and eight scene-remount observations. U10: ten-section report and fifteen-slide editable deck, source notes and current handoff.

139 React tests + 16 service tests pass. Original prototype, scientific identities and geometry remain preserved. Earlier Ollama evaluation: 39/39 authored cases, including 27 real local calls. These checks do not establish student learning, physical safety or production readiness.

External checks remain explicit: spoken screen reader, real browser zoom, second browser/physical device, native download completion and human presenter rehearsal. Live sensor streams, shared authenticated operations and institutional/site approval are separate integrations.

Secondary research only: fourteen sources, zero local participants. Modelled energy upper bounds are not measured savings. Local Ollama reads reviewed public guides only. Team identities/contributions and the deadline year remain unconfirmed.
